name: cadence-release-toolchain
description: Pinned semantic-release toolchain for the release job in ci.yml. The lockfile is the supply-chain pin: CI installs exactly these bytes via `npm ci` instead of resolving packages from the registry at release time. Update via Dependabot PRs only. NOTE: conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits is coupled to the conventional-changelog-writer that semantic-release bundles — v10 renamed writerOpts.mainTemplate to .template, which the bundled writer v8 does not read, so notes silently render as a bare header. Hold at 9.x until semantic-release ships writer v9; .github/scripts/test-release-parser.mjs fails if a bump breaks rendering.
